records.name: Medicaid Nonemergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) / Medical Transportation Program
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission
records.description_en: Free rides to Medicaid doctor visits, pharmacies, and other covered health care. Rides can be by city bus, taxi or van, and sometimes gas money is paid back if you or a friend drive.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people enrolled in Medicaid, the Children with Special Health Care Needs program, or the Transportation for Indigent Cancer Patients program who have no other way to get to their appointment.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident enrolled in Medicaid, CSHCN, or Transportation for Indigent Cancer Patients

documents_needed: Medicaid ID number or Social Security number
Doctor or clinic name, address and phone
Pickup address
Appointment date, time and reason
records.how_to_apply: If you have a Medicaid health plan, call your plan's medical transportation number. If you do not have a health plan, call 877-MED-TRIP. Call at least 2 workdays before your visit (5 workdays for visits outside your county).
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. local time (for scheduling)
records.notes: 877-MED-TRIP is for people WITHOUT a Medicaid health plan. Health plan ride lines (from HHS contact page): Aetna 1-866-411-8920; Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas 1-866-824-1565; Community First 1-855-932-2335; Community Health Choice 1-844-572-8194; Cook Children's 1-844-572-8195; Dell Children's 1-844-867-2742; Driscoll 1-833-694-5881; El Paso Health 1-833-931-3844; Molina 1-866-462-4857; Parkland Community Health Plan 1-833-931-3844; Superior 1-855-932-2318; Texas Children's 1-888-583-0110; UnitedHealthcare 1-888-462-6050; Wellpoint STAR 1-833-721-8184, STAR+PLUS 1-844-867-2837, STAR Kids 1-844-864-2443, MMP 1-844-869-2767. Same-day rides may be approved for urgent care, hospital discharge, or pharmacy trips. People who own a car can ask for an Individual Transportation Participant (ITP) application for gas reimbursement. Meals/lodging may be covered for members under 21. Full plan list: https://www.hhs.texas.gov/services/health/medicaid-chip/medicaid-chip-members/nonemergency-medical-transportation-program/health-plan-transportation-contact-information
records.description_es: Viajes gratis a citas médicas de Medicaid, a la farmacia y a otros servicios de salud cubiertos. Los viajes pueden ser en autobús, taxi o camioneta. A veces le devuelven el dinero de la gasolina si usted o un amigo manejan.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas inscritas en Medicaid, en el programa para Niños con Necesidades Especiales de Salud (CSHCN) o en el programa de Transporte para Pacientes de Cáncer de Bajos Recursos, que no tienen otra forma de llegar a su cita.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si tiene un plan de salud de Medicaid, llame al número de transporte médico de su plan. Si no tiene plan de salud, llame al 877-MED-TRIP (877-633-8747). Llame por lo menos 2 días hábiles antes de su cita (5 días hábiles si la cita es fuera de su condado).

records.name: VA Beneficiary Travel Pay Reimbursement
records.description_en: Pays veterans back for mileage, parking and tolls when they travel to VA or approved community care. Some bus, taxi, meals and lodging can be covered with approval first.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans going to VA or approved community care who also meet a rule such as a 30% or higher disability rating, care for a service-connected condition, getting a VA pension, low income, being unable to afford the trip, or traveling for a C&P exam. Some caregivers and attendants can also qualify.
documents_needed: Receipts for parking, tolls or other costs
Mileage information
Direct deposit information
records.how_to_apply: File online through the Beneficiary Travel Self-Service System (BTSSS) or mail VA Form 10-3542 to your VA facility. File within 30 days of your appointment.
records.notes: Claims filed after 30 days are usually denied. Bus, taxi, rideshare, meals and lodging need preapproval; mileage, parking and tolls do not. Contact your VA facility's Beneficiary Travel Office for help.
records.description_es: Le devuelve a los veteranos el dinero de millas, estacionamiento y peajes cuando van al VA o a un proveedor aprobado. Con permiso antes del viaje, también se pueden cubrir autobús, taxi, comidas y hospedaje.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos que van al VA o a atención aprobada en la comunidad y que además cumplen una regla, por ejemplo: discapacidad de 30% o más, tratamiento de una condición relacionada con el servicio, pensión del VA, bajos ingresos, no poder pagar el viaje o ir a un examen de C&P. Algunos cuidadores y acompañantes también pueden calificar.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su reclamo en línea en el sistema BTSSS o envíe el formulario VA 10-3542 por correo o en persona a su centro del VA. Hágalo dentro de los 30 días después de su cita.

records.name: Free Driver License or ID Card for Disabled Veterans
records.description_en: Disabled veterans who qualify can get a Texas driver license or ID card for free. The veteran designation can also be added at no charge.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans with a service-related disability rating of at least 60%, an honorable discharge, and VA disability pay who are not required to register as a sex offender. Does not apply to commercial driver licenses (CDL).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident

documents_needed: Signed VA disability letter, OR official documents showing honorable discharge, disability rating and disability compensation
Documents proving citizenship/lawful presence, Texas residency and identity
records.how_to_apply: Make an appointment at a Texas driver license office and bring your VA disability documents. After your status is verified, you can use DPS online services for fee-exempt renewals.
records.notes: DPS fee page also shows a reduced ID card fee for people age 60 and older (reduced, not free). DPS pages checked did not list a homeless or foster-youth fee waiver.
records.description_es: Los veteranos con discapacidad que califican pueden sacar su licencia de manejar o su tarjeta de identificación de Texas gratis. También pueden agregar la marca de veterano sin costo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos con una discapacidad relacionada con el servicio de por lo menos 60%, baja honorable y pago por discapacidad del VA, que no tengan que registrarse como agresores sexuales. No aplica a licencias comerciales (CDL).
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita en una oficina de licencias de manejar de Texas y lleve sus documentos de discapacidad del VA. Después de que verifiquen su estado, puede usar los servicios en línea del DPS para renovar sin costo.

records.name: Election Identification Certificate (EIC)
records.description_en: A free photo ID card that can be used for voting in Texas. It is good for six years (no expiration for people 70 and older).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Registered Texas voters (or people applying to register) at least 17 years and 10 months old who do not already have a valid Texas driver license, ID, passport, military ID or handgun license.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Texas resident, registered voter

documents_needed: Proof of U.S. citizenship
Proof of identity
Voter registration card (or register at the office)
Name change documents if needed
records.how_to_apply: Schedule an appointment at any Texas driver license office and fill out form DL-14C (English or Spanish). Bring original or certified copies of your documents; photocopies are not accepted.
records.notes: The EIC is only for voting; it cannot be used as a driver license or general ID card.
records.description_es: Una identificación con foto, gratis, que sirve para votar en Texas. Es válida por seis años (no se vence para personas de 70 años o más).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Votantes registrados en Texas (o personas que se están registrando) de por lo menos 17 años y 10 meses, que no tengan ya una licencia de manejar, identificación de Texas, pasaporte, identificación militar o licencia de armas vigente.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita en cualquier oficina de licencias de manejar de Texas y llene el formulario DL-14C (en inglés o español). Lleve sus documentos originales o copias certificadas; no aceptan fotocopias.

records.name: CapMetro Equifare (Low-Income Fare)
records.description_en: Cheaper bus and train rides for low-income riders in the Austin area. Local bus rides are $1.00 and commuter bus or rail rides are $3.00. Once you have paid as much as a day or month pass, the rest of your rides that day or month are free.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households with income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level, or people enrolled in a social services program such as Medicaid, SNAP or SSI.
documents_needed: Proof of eligibility such as SNAP/EBT card, Social Security award letter, pay stub or tax return (self-verification allowed; may be audited)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or get a paper form at the CapMetro Transit Store at 1705 Guadalupe St. Approval usually takes 4-6 business days and you get an email.
records.hours: Transit Store: weekdays 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Reduced fare: $1.00 local ride; $3.00 commuter bus/rail; automatic daily and monthly fare caps
records.notes: Approval lasts 24 months, then you must re-enroll. Must use the CapMetro Reloadable Fare Card or Umo app. Email Equifare@capmetro.org. Riders under 18 ride free on CapMetro.
records.description_es: Viajes más baratos en autobús y tren para personas de bajos ingresos en el área de Austin. Un viaje en autobús local cuesta $1.00 y en autobús de cercanías o tren $3.00. Cuando ya pagó lo mismo que un pase de un día o de un mes, los demás viajes de ese día o mes son gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares con ingresos iguales o menores al 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, o personas inscritas en un programa de ayuda como Medicaid, SNAP o SSI.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea o pida un formulario en papel en la Tienda de CapMetro (Transit Store) en 1705 Guadalupe St. La aprobación normalmente tarda de 4 a 6 días hábiles y le avisan por correo electrónico.

records.name: CapMetro Reduced Fare (Seniors, Medicare, Disability, Military)
records.description_en: Half-price bus and rail fares in the Austin area. Local rides are $0.60, a day of rides is $1.25 and a month is $20.60 with a Reduced Fare ID.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 65 and older, anyone with a Medicare card, riders with disabilities, and active or reserve military ID holders not in uniform.
documents_needed: Valid government-issued ID
Proof of eligibility (age, Medicare card, disability, or military ID)
records.how_to_apply: Seniors, Medicare card holders and active military can apply online. You can also go to the Transit Store at 1705 Guadalupe St. with a government-issued ID, or call 512-389-7475 to get an application by mail. Riders with disabilities can download the disability application from CapMetro's website.
records.hours: Transit Store: weekdays 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.cost: Reduced Fare ID card $3 (good for 2 years). Reduced fares: $0.60 local ride; $1.25 per day; $20.60 per month
records.notes: Eligibility is any one of: age 65+, Medicare card, disability, or active/reserve military ID (not in uniform). Children under 18 and uniformed military/emergency personnel ride free. General CapMetro GO Line: 512-474-1200. Spanish and accessible forms available by request (requestformailouts@capmetro.org).
records.description_es: Pasajes de autobús y tren a mitad de precio en el área de Austin. Con la identificación de tarifa reducida, un viaje local cuesta $0.60, un día de viajes $1.25 y un mes $20.60.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 65 años o más, cualquier persona con tarjeta de Medicare, pasajeros con discapacidad y militares activos o de reserva con identificación que no estén en uniforme.
records.how_to_apply_es: Las personas mayores, las que tienen Medicare y los militares activos pueden aplicar en línea. También puede ir a la Tienda de CapMetro en 1705 Guadalupe St. con una identificación del gobierno, o llamar al 512-389-7475 para que le manden una solicitud por correo. Las personas con discapacidad pueden bajar la solicitud de discapacidad del sitio web de CapMetro.

records.name: CapMetro Access (ADA Paratransit)
records.description_en: Shared-ride van service for people whose disability keeps them from using regular buses and trains in the Austin area. Free travel training is also offered.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People whose disability prevents them from using CapMetro fixed-route bus and rail, for trips within 3/4 mile of fixed routes.
documents_needed: Completed two-part application (Part A and Part B)
records.how_to_apply: Complete Part A online (and send the Part B link to your health care provider), or print the application, have a health care professional fill out Part B, and send it by fax, mail or email to eligibility@capmetro.org. An in-person eligibility review is part of the process. Once approved, book rides by phone or the Access app.
records.hours: Phone: weekdays 7 a.m.-6 p.m., weekends 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Eligibility questions: (512) 389-7501. Travel training: (512) 369-6083.
records.description_es: Servicio de camioneta compartida para personas en el área de Austin que por su discapacidad no pueden usar los autobuses y trenes normales. También ofrecen entrenamiento gratis para aprender a usar el transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que por su discapacidad no pueden usar los autobuses y trenes regulares de CapMetro, para viajes a no más de 3/4 de milla de las rutas regulares.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la Parte A en línea (y mande el enlace de la Parte B a su proveedor de salud), o imprima la solicitud, pida a un profesional de salud que llene la Parte B y envíela por fax, correo o a eligibility@capmetro.org. Hay una revisión en persona. Cuando lo aprueben, pida sus viajes por teléfono o con la aplicación Access.

records.name: METRO Discounted Fares / RideMETRO Discount Fare Card
records.organization: Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County (METRO)
records.description_en: Half-price ($0.60) rides for students, seniors 65-69 and people with disabilities in Houston, and free rides for seniors 70+ and qualified veterans with a Discount Fare Card.
records.eligibility_summary_en: K-12 and college students, seniors 65 and older, people with disabilities, and qualified veterans. Children 5 and under ride free with an adult.
documents_needed: Government-issued photo ID with date of birth (seniors)
Doctor's statement on letterhead or VA 'Service Connected' ID (disability)
Class schedule/report card (K-12) or class schedule with tuition receipt (college)
Application signed and stamped by the VA office (veterans)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at the METRO Online RideStore and upload documents (card is mailed), or visit a METRO RideStore in person.
records.hours: Downtown Transit Center RideStore: Mon-Fri, 7 a.m.-6 p.m.
records.cost: $0.60 half fare; free for seniors 70+ and qualified veterans
records.notes: Other RideStores at Eastwood, Fannin South, Fifth Ward/Denver Harbor, Kashmere, Magnolia Park, Main Street Square, Mission Bend, Northline, Northwest, Southeast, TMC and Wheeler Station transit centers (Mon-Fri 8 a.m.-5 p.m.). K-12 students applying in person need a parent or guardian. Card can be converted to a virtual card in the RideMETRO app. Veterans pass is for veterans with valor medals or service-connected disabilities.
records.description_es: Viajes a mitad de precio ($0.60) en Houston para estudiantes, personas de 65 a 69 años y personas con discapacidad. Viajes gratis para personas de 70 años o más y veteranos que califican, con la Tarjeta de Tarifa con Descuento.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado y universitarios, personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad y veteranos que califican. Los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis con un adulto.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en la RideStore en línea de METRO y suba sus documentos (le mandan la tarjeta por correo), o vaya en persona a una RideStore de METRO.

records.name: METROLift (ADA Paratransit)
records.organization: Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County (METRO)
records.description_en: Shared-ride paratransit service for people with disabilities across most of Harris County. One attendant rides free.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People whose disability keeps them from getting to a bus stop, boarding, or using other METRO service without help.
documents_needed: Completed application
Physician certification form
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the signed physician certification form, or call to get a paper application and mail it to METROLift Eligibility, P.O. Box 61429, Houston, TX 77208-1429. All applicants have an in-person interview; decision within 21 days.
records.hours: Customer service Mon-Fri, 10 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.notes: Scheduling (Mon-Sun 5 a.m.-5 p.m.): automated 713-739-4690; AI assistant 346-245-5189 (English), 346-477-9540 (Spanish). Book one day before travel; on Fridays you can book for Saturday, Sunday and Monday.
records.description_es: Servicio de transporte compartido para personas con discapacidad en casi todo el condado de Harris. Un acompañante viaja gratis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que por su discapacidad no pueden llegar a una parada de autobús, subir al autobús o usar otros servicios de METRO sin ayuda.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea con el formulario de certificación firmado por su médico, o llame para pedir una solicitud en papel y envíela por correo a METROLift Eligibility, P.O. Box 61429, Houston, TX 77208-1429. Todas las personas tienen una entrevista en persona; la decisión llega por escrito en un plazo de 21 días.

records.name: DART Discount GoPass Tap Card (Low-Income)
records.description_en: A reloadable card that gives half-price local bus and train fares to people in assistance programs. Daily and monthly fare caps apply.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People enrolled in SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, TANF, WIC, Medicare, CEAP, Housing Choice Voucher, Dallas Housing Authority, or Parkland Financial Assistance.
documents_needed: Current program card with expiration date or agency letter with your name
Headshot photo
records.how_to_apply: Register online or call DART. The card is mailed within 15 business days.
records.cost: 50% off local fares; $6 minimum first load
records.notes: Counties from TxDOT transit directory for DART's service area; DART serves specific member cities only.
records.description_es: Una tarjeta recargable que da pasajes a mitad de precio en autobuses y trenes locales para personas en programas de ayuda. Tiene límites diarios y mensuales, así que nunca paga más que un pase.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas inscritas en SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, TANF, WIC, Medicare, CEAP, el programa de vales de vivienda (Housing Choice Voucher), la Autoridad de Vivienda de Dallas o la Asistencia Financiera de Parkland.
records.how_to_apply_es: Regístrese en línea o llame a DART al 972-482-4052. Le mandan la tarjeta por correo en un plazo de 15 días hábiles.

records.name: DART Reduced Fare GoPass Tap Card (Seniors, Disability, Veterans, Students)
records.description_en: 50% off DART fares for seniors, veterans, people with disabilities, children and students.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 65+, veterans, people with disabilities, children 5-14, high school students, and full-time college or trade school students.
documents_needed: DART-issued photo ID
Medical certificate or state/federal disability ID (for disability)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the DART Access portal using the link for your category.
records.hours: Phone: 7 a.m.-12 a.m. daily; holidays 8 a.m.-5 p.m. (closed Thanksgiving and Christmas)
records.notes: Eligibility is any one of the listed groups (senior OR disability OR veteran OR student). Children under 5 ride free with a paying adult (up to 2 children). Processing: veterans 7-10 business days; seniors about 15 business days.
records.description_es: 50% de descuento en los pasajes de DART para personas mayores, veteranos, personas con discapacidad, niños y estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 65 años o más, veteranos, personas con discapacidad, niños de 5 a 14 años, estudiantes de preparatoria y estudiantes universitarios o de escuela técnica de tiempo completo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en línea en el portal DART Access usando el enlace para su grupo.

records.name: DART Paratransit Services (ADA)
records.description_en: Door-to-door rides for people with disabilities who cannot use DART buses or trains.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with disabilities who meet ADA paratransit rules; some riders get conditional eligibility for certain trips only.
records.how_to_apply: Call DART Paratransit Certification at 214-828-6717 (Mon-Fri, 8 a.m.-5 p.m.) to start the application. Once approved, book rides online 24/7 or by phone at 214-515-7272.
records.hours: Live scheduling Mon-Fri, 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; web booking 24/7
records.cost: $3.50 per ride; $35 10-trip booklet; personal care attendants free
records.notes: Service area: Addison, Carrollton, Cockrell Hill, Dallas, Farmers Branch, Garland, Glenn Heights, Irving, Plano, Richardson, Rowlett, University Park, and DFW Airport. Customer Relations 214-828-6736 (Mon-Fri 8-5). Coupon booklets sold online or at DARTmart, 1401 Pacific Ave.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta para personas con discapacidad que no pueden usar los autobuses o trenes de DART.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con discapacidad que cumplen las reglas de la ley ADA para transporte especial; algunas personas califican solo para ciertos viajes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Certificación de Paratránsito de DART al 214-828-6717 (lunes a viernes, 8 a.m. a 5 p.m.) para empezar la solicitud. Cuando lo aprueben, pida sus viajes en línea a cualquier hora o por teléfono al 214-515-7272.

records.name: VIA Reduced Fares
records.description_en: Lower bus fares in San Antonio for seniors, students, children, people with disabilities, Medicare/SSDI recipients and military. Seniors pay 25 cents midday on weekdays and ride free on weekends.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 62+, students, children 5-13, people with certain disabilities (including veterans rated 80%+), Medicare and SSDI recipients, and active-duty military.
documents_needed: Government-issued ID with date of birth
Proof of school enrollment and paid tuition (students)
Medicare card or SSDI award letter
VA disability documentation (veterans)
records.how_to_apply: Get a VIA Reduced Fare ID at a VIA Information Center (any except Randolph Transit Center).
records.cost: Reduced fares; seniors $0.25 weekdays 9 a.m.-3 p.m., free Sat/Sun
records.notes: Students 12-18 can get free Semester Passes. Children 4 and under ride free. Eligibility is any one of the listed groups.
records.description_es: Pasajes de autobús más baratos en San Antonio para personas mayores, estudiantes, niños, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare o SSDI y militares. Las personas mayores pagan 25 centavos entre semana de 9 a.m. a 3 p.m. y viajan gratis los fines de semana.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 62 años o más, estudiantes, niños de 5 a 13 años, personas con ciertas discapacidades (incluso veteranos con 80% o más), personas con Medicare o SSDI y militares en servicio activo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Saque su identificación de Tarifa Reducida de VIA en un Centro de Información de VIA (en cualquiera menos el de Randolph Transit Center).

records.name: VIAtrans Paratransit
records.description_en: Curb-to-curb shared rides for people whose disability keeps them from using regular VIA buses, during the same hours and areas as VIA bus service.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People age 6 and older whose disability substantially limits their ability to use public transit. Age, income and driving ability do not matter.
documents_needed: Completed application
Medical professional verification
records.how_to_apply: Fill out pages 1-4 of the application and have a medical professional fill out pages 5-7. Send it by mail or bring it to any VIA transit center. You may need a functional assessment. You will get a letter within 21 days.
records.hours: Accessible Services: weekdays 8 a.m.-4 p.m.; rides 4 a.m.-midnight
records.notes: Reservations: 210-362-5050 (1 day ahead: 8 a.m.-4:45 p.m. daily; 2-4 days ahead: 8 a.m.-8 p.m. Mon-Thu). Customer service: 210-362-2020. Eligibility is not based on income or residency.
records.description_es: Viajes compartidos de acera a acera para personas que por su discapacidad no pueden usar los autobuses regulares de VIA, en los mismos horarios y zonas que los autobuses de VIA.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 6 años o más cuya discapacidad les limita mucho usar el transporte público. No importa la edad, los ingresos ni si maneja.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene las páginas 1 a 4 de la solicitud y pida a un profesional médico que llene las páginas 5 a 7. Envíela por correo o llévela a cualquier centro de tránsito de VIA. Tal vez le hagan una evaluación. Le mandan una carta en un plazo de 21 días.

records.name: Trinity Metro Reduced Fare ID
records.description_en: Lower fares in Fort Worth for seniors, people with disabilities, youth, Medicare card holders and veterans. A local ride is $1 and a day pass is $2.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People 65 and older, people with disabilities, youth ages 5-19, Medicare card holders, and veterans (veterans on Local tickets only).
documents_needed: Proof of age (Texas ID, driver license, Medicare card or birth certificate) for seniors
Medicare card, Social Security award letter, or VA benefits letter plus state ID for disability
Proof of veteran status
records.how_to_apply: Bring your documents to Fort Worth Central Station to get a photo Reduced Fare ID.
records.cost: $2 for photo ID card ($10 replacement). Reduced fares: $1 local ride; $2 day pass; $9 7-day pass
records.notes: ID cards expire after 6 months to 2 years and must be renewed.
records.description_es: Pasajes más baratos en Fort Worth para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, jóvenes, personas con Medicare y veteranos. Un viaje local cuesta $1 y un pase de un día $2.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad, jóvenes de 5 a 19 años, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y veteranos (los veteranos solo en boletos locales).
records.how_to_apply_es: Lleve sus documentos a la estación Fort Worth Central Station (1001 Jones Street) para sacar su identificación de Tarifa Reducida con foto.

records.name: Trinity Metro ACCESS Paratransit
records.description_en: Door-to-door rides for people with a verified disability that keeps them from riding regular buses in Fort Worth and River Oaks.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with a verified disability that prevents them from riding regular city bus service.
documents_needed: Completed application
records.how_to_apply: Download the application (English or Spanish) or call Trinity Metro to get one. Processing can take up to 21 days. Book trips by phone up to 7 days ahead, until 5 p.m. the day before.
records.hours: Reservations Mon-Fri, 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; rides about 4:20 a.m.-11:15 p.m. (Sunday from 6 a.m.)
records.cost: $4 one-way; $40 ten-ride book; personal care attendants free
records.notes: Serves Fort Worth and River Oaks only. Certification lasts up to 2 years.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta para personas con una discapacidad comprobada que no pueden usar los autobuses regulares en Fort Worth y River Oaks.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con una discapacidad comprobada que no les permite usar el servicio regular de autobús de la ciudad.
records.how_to_apply_es: Baje la solicitud (en inglés o español) o llame a Trinity Metro para pedirla. El trámite puede tardar hasta 21 días. Pida sus viajes por teléfono hasta 7 días antes, a más tardar a las 5 p.m. del día anterior.

records.name: Sun Metro Reduced Fare ID
records.description_en: Lower bus fares in El Paso for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, military and students. The ID is free once approved.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People 65 and older, certified persons with disabilities, Medicare card holders, military (active duty, retirees, dependents) and students.
documents_needed: Government-issued photo ID with date of birth, or valid Enhanced Library Card (seniors)
Medical disability certification (Social Security disability letters are not accepted)
Valid military ID (military)
records.how_to_apply: Apply at a Sun Metro ticket office. Call 915-212-3333 to find ticket office locations.
records.cost: ID free once approved ($5 replacement); reduced fares
records.notes: Permanent disability IDs last 5 years; temporary ones 12 months or less.
records.description_es: Pasajes de autobús más baratos en El Paso para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare, militares y estudiantes. La identificación es gratis cuando lo aprueban.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad certificada, personas con tarjeta de Medicare, militares (activos, retirados y sus familiares) y estudiantes.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga la solicitud en una oficina de boletos de Sun Metro. Llame al 915-212-3333 para saber dónde están.

records.name: Sun Metro LIFT Paratransit
records.description_en: Paratransit rides in El Paso for people whose disability keeps them from using regular buses.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with a disability that keeps them from getting to bus stops, or boarding and riding buses on their own.
documents_needed: LIFT Application
Paratransit Verification Form completed by a doctor or LIFT representative
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the LIFT application and Paratransit Verification Form and send by email, mail or in person.
records.hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
records.notes: Visitors can use LIFT up to 21 days a year. Denials can be appealed within 65 days. Temporary and conditional eligibility are available; permanent eligibility is rechecked every 3 years.
records.description_es: Viajes de transporte especial en El Paso para personas que por su discapacidad no pueden usar los autobuses regulares.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con una discapacidad que no les deja llegar a las paradas de autobús, o subir y viajar en el autobús por su cuenta.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud de LIFT y el Formulario de Verificación de Paratránsito, y envíelos por correo electrónico, por correo o en persona (5081 Fred Wilson Ave., lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m.).

records.name: DCTA Reduced Fare Eligible Badge
records.description_en: Lower fares on DCTA buses and trains for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders and students.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 65+, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, and students ages 6-18 with valid ID. Children 5 and under ride free.
documents_needed: DCTA reduced fare application
Proof of eligibility
records.how_to_apply: Download the reduced fare application (English, Spanish or Hakha Chin) from DCTA's website and get a Reduced Fare Eligible badge. The badge must be shown with a reduced fare pass.
records.notes: DCTA also has a Non-Profit Discount Program for agencies.
records.description_es: Pasajes más baratos en los autobuses y trenes de DCTA para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, personas con Medicare y estudiantes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad, personas con tarjeta de Medicare y estudiantes de 6 a 18 años con identificación. Los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis.
records.how_to_apply_es: Baje la solicitud de tarifa reducida (en inglés, español o hakha chin) del sitio web de DCTA para sacar su gafete de Tarifa Reducida. Debe mostrar el gafete junto con un pase de tarifa reducida.

records.name: Trinity Metro On-Demand
records.description_en: App or phone-booked shared rides in seven Tarrant County zones for a flat $2, or free with any multi-ride Trinity Metro ticket.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public in the Alliance, Mercantile, North Side, Southeast, Southside, South Tarrant and TCC Northeast zones.

records.description_es: Viajes compartidos que se piden por aplicación o por teléfono en siete zonas del condado de Tarrant. Cuestan $2, o son gratis si tiene cualquier boleto de varios viajes de Trinity Metro.

records.description_es: Viajes en autobús y camioneta para personas que viven en zonas rurales. Muchas veces hay que llamar antes para pedir el viaje. Puede usarlos para ir al trabajo, al doctor, a hacer compras y otros mandados.
